visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a main female character with silver-toned hair, wearing a beige mesh long-sleeve crop top over a black inner top and loose beige cargo trousers, standing in a brightly lit urban shopping street. She holds a small black microphone and speaks directly into the lens with a wide, expressive smile and frequent hand movements. Behind her, blurry passers-by and storefronts like Swatch and RhinoShield are visible under natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a young female interviewee with dark hair in a grey shirt and white shorts, holding a white thermos bottle. The main creator engages her in conversation on the busy sidewalk with many people walking in the background. (3) The creator then interviews a young man in a white t-shirt who gestures towards his head and backpack while laughing during the exchange. The setting is a paved outdoor plaza with modern architecture. (4) The next phase features a young woman in a white long-sleeve graphic shirt holding a red candied fruit snack on a stick (tanghulu) while speaking into the microphone. She appears focused on her phone intermittently. (5) The creator interviews a couple in front of a colorful retail background featuring gashapon machines; the woman wears a white tank top and the man a white t-shirt with arm tattoos. (6) Finally, the creator is seen kneeling on the pavement, petting a Golden Retriever dog on a leash, smiling and looking towards the camera in a closing shot.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 終於來到我們新企劃. [Logo]: @pkky.3. (2) [Subtitle]: 街訪王訪肉. (3) [Subtitle]: 來我們今天街訪題目是什麼? (4) [Subtitle]: 想要問女生 月經來的時候 是衰還是旺? (5) [Subtitle]: 那你是旺還是衰? 我是衰. (6) [Subtitle]: 我們就去問問看 Go. (7) [Subtitle]: 你有覺得月經來的時候 會特別衰或特別...特別幸運嗎? (8) [Subtitle]: 衰的時候 一些轉運的妙招? 沒有欸. (9) [Subtitle]: 他都會拐我. (10) [Subtitle]: 怎麼拐? 怎麼拐? 按我骰子 然後把我牌弄掉. (11) [Subtitle]: 請問你們會打麻將嗎? (12) [Subtitle]: 肚子很痛 但是還是要打麻將. (13) [Subtitle]: 紅中要放在中間 然後就摸得到那張牌 只要丟掉. (14) [Subtitle]: 牌子要丟掉? 什麼意思? 就是不用牌尺打. (15) [Subtitle]: 拿第一手的時候要用左手拿. (16) [Subtitle]: 我會踢椅腳兩下. (17) [Subtitle]: 你平常會打麻將嗎?
